S1_concentration.interpretation_policy: Descriptive contributions and leave-one-period-out totals only; no dominance or quality threshold.

definitions.calendar: UTC entry calendar; completed-trade profit attributed entirely to entry year/month
definitions.empty_period: N=0, net=0; WR and expectancy null; excluded from positive/negative/zero counts
definitions.population: exactly existing MATCHED rows; no reassignment, warm-up or eligibility changes
definitions.profit: existing ledger profit: net EUR cash including costs; decimal summation of stored values
definitions.profit_contribution: signed yearly net / total S1 net; may be negative or exceed 100%; undefined if total net zero
definitions.win_rate: wins/N, fraction 0..1; null for empty periods
